segments.source: The following listing shows the TVML for an `alertTemplate` example:
segments.normalizedSource: The following listing shows the TVML for an `alertTemplate` example:
segments.contextBefore: Example
segments.contextAfter:
```xml
<document>
   <alertTemplate>
      <title>Update Available</title>
      <description>Get the latest tvOS version</description>
      <button>
         <text>Update Now</text>
      </button>
      <button>
         <text>Cancel</text>
      </button>
   </alertTemplate>
</document>
```
